|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Coruscant: The Works (ALT)]] (version 2 of 3). The image here is the Players Committee card image published 13 July 2023. The current text is [[Coruscant: The Works (ALT) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image that differs visibly from the one before is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Coruscant: The Works (ALT)]]): Alternate-image card image first published 13 July 2023<ref name="img-o">Players Committee card image as published: <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/coruscanttheworks_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a98bff721d819e36b343e60587d658ef767b2fba/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/coruscanttheworks_ai.png holotable commit a98bff7], 13 July 2023) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same image).</ref>: “Light: - Dark: May deploy non-[Theed Palace] Sidious here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If your [Special Edition] objective on table, gains one [Light Side] icon and opponent's Force drains are +2 here.” This first upload exists only as the <code>hires</code> PNG; it was replaced the same day. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints “E1” although it is the first image of this alternate-image card; the mark is the base card's errata mark (the alternate image reprints the errata text of [[Coruscant: The Works]]), not a count of this card's versions. Recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Card image published 13 July 2023<ref name="img-PC-E1">Players Committee card image as published: <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/coruscanttheworks_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2e6b92fecff4d08d9a08ec90a6634eeec690dd6b/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/coruscanttheworks_ai.png holotable commit 2e6b92f], 13 July 2023); <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/coruscanttheworks_ai.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/bf1d08e0b82f40b5422be00dcc4c3a781c1dbefd/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/coruscanttheworks_ai.gif holotable commit bf1d08e], 14 July 2023) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same image).</ref>: “Light: - Dark: May deploy non-[Theed Palace] Sidious here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If your [Special Edition] objective on table, gains one [Light Side] icon and opponent's Force drains are +2 here.” '''What changed:''' The PC re-uploaded the image the same day turned to landscape (the way location cards are shown); the card itself is unchanged (the first upload showed the card standing upright, rotated 90°).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Coruscant: The Works (ALT) (Errata 2)]]): Card image published 24 January 2025 (current; the image the PC card data uses)<ref name="img-PC-E2">Players Committee card image as published: <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/coruscanttheworks_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/4e02a97c1fba579100b28aa03ff6dd9c334708d2/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/coruscanttheworks_ai.png holotable commit 4e02a97], 24 January 2025); <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/coruscanttheworks_ai.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e083be48ab147a9c9a69d055ec2467a29b3f0225/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/coruscanttheworks_ai.gif holotable commit e083be4], 24 January 2025) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same image).</ref>: “Light: - Dark: May deploy non-[Theed Palace] Sidious here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If your [Special Edition] objective on table, gains one [Light Side] icon and opponent's Force drains are +2 here.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints “E1” but is errata 2 of this alternate-image card in release order; the mark follows the base card's errata ([[Coruscant: The Works]]), not this card's versions. Recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' The words “Official AI - 2022 3 of 9” beside the margin name at the bottom were removed (the Players Committee logo stays beside “(AI) E1”); nothing else visible changed.
